content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `IOUtils.copyBytes` method suppressing exceptions that occurred during the closure of input and output streams. Specifically, when the `close` parameter was set to true, the method would attempt to close both streams, but if an exception was thrown during the closure of the output stream, it was not propagated, leading to silent failures. The patch introduced a change to ensure that any exceptions thrown during the closure of the streams are properly thrown out, allowing the caller to handle them appropriately.
